name: Cylla
source:
Cylla is the second pilot of your ship, the Calliste-17. She's gruff, sturdy and has no room for nonsense, but regardless, is reliable when in a pinch.

"You don't need me to hold your hand. Fix it yourself."

[From [url=https://helloyinny.itch.io/deep-breaths]itch.io[/url]]
